​  
Quick reframe for fun: time-wise, you and I are closer to Cleopatra’s life (70/69 BC–10 August 30 BC) than Cleopatra was to the construction of the pyramids (c. 2570 BC).  
​  
Huge thanks to T. Face for the above recommendations!

bullets.title: Arnold
bullets.note: This was recommended to me by at least a dozen friends, and it doesn’t disappoint. This three-part miniseries is from the same producers who gave us [_The Defiant Ones_](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt6958022/). The official description: “This intimate docuseries follows [Arnold Schwarzenegger](https://tim.blog/2015/02/02/arnold-schwarzenegger/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf)’s multifaceted life and career, from bodybuilding champ to Hollywood icon to politician.”

bullets.title: “To learn to be always in a state of meditation means never to let your vital energy wane. You would never allow it to do so if it were certain that you were to die tomorrow. It wanes because you forget about death. Grit your teeth, fix your gaze, and observe death at this moment. You have to feel it so strongly that it seems as if it’s attacking you. Fearless energy comes from this. At this moment, death is right before your eyes. It’s not something you can afford to neglect.” — Suzuki Shōsan (1579–1655) (Click here to share on Twitter.) * * * You can complement this edition of 5-Bullet Friday with my brand-new interview with Nassim Nicholas Taleb and Scott Patterson, my conversation with Arnold Schwarzenegger, and my interview with Tyler Cowen.
